en: The image shows the written/mailed side of a vintage brown postcard labeled 'CARTE POSTALE' in blue. Two French stamps (one red 50c and one blue 25c, both 'REPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE') are affixed in the upper right corner and canceled with circular Paris postmarks dated 1932. The recipient's address is handwritten in ink on the right, including an address in Amsterdam, Netherlands, while the sender's name and Paris return address are written diagonally at upper left. There are additional light pencil notes in the correspondence area.
